incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=autoscaler-queue-monitor severity=high queue_delay=130s affected=production region=us-west-2

PagerDuty: Page 12345 fired • Unacked

Anna (oncall): acked. I'm on it, scooping logs + metrics :eyes:

Matt (eng): grabbing HPA metrics, looks like metrics API errors spike at the same time

Sophie (sre): pulling node events — seeing a flood of pod evictions from spot preemption in us-west-2, several nodes reclaimed within minutes

Anna (oncall): topology: router -> dispatcher -> inference-queue; queue depth at ~42k, p95 latency jumped from 2.3s -> 14.7s

Anna (oncall): quick check: autoscaler controller logs show 'scale_up_inhibited' errors; investigating whether HPA failed to read metrics

Matt (eng): ran `kubectl -n inference get hpa autoscaler-dispatcher -o yaml`

Matt (eng): ```
# snippet
status:
  currentMetrics: []
  conditions:
  - type: AbleToScale
    status: "False"
    reason: FailedGetMetrics
    message: "metrics API returned 503"
``` 

Sophie (sre): metrics-server is flapping; pods can't read custom.metrics. That would make HPA inert

Ops ShiftLead: any immediate customer impact? seeing increased 5xx counts?

Anna (oncall): yes — upstream dispatcher returning 503/429 for some requests. Support already triaging a handful of SEV reports from customers on hosted API

Matt (eng): mitigation plan (short): 1) manual replica bump on dispatcher to add capacity 2) temporary rate-limits for non-critical tiers 3) restart metrics-server + investigate certs

Sophie (sre): I'll restart metrics-server and check kube-controller-manager logs for related errors

Anna (oncall): scaling now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/dispatcher --replicas=24`

deploy-bot: scaling deployment/dispatcher to 24 replicas

Anna (oncall): scaled. watching queue depth and latency charts

Sophie (sre): restarted metrics-server pods; logs show a cert rotation failure causing crashloops — rotating certs now as a hotfix

Matt (eng): applying temporary ratelimit rule at edge: non-paid tier -> 0.75 rps. Pushing rule now

Anna (oncall): queue depth: 42k -> 16k within ~3m after scale + rate-limit. p95 latency down to ~4.8s

PagerDuty: Page 12345 acknowledged by Anna (oncall), escalated to Sophie (sre) after 6m

Ops ShiftLead: moving incident to #incidents for longer analysis and postmortem. Please drop commands + logs there. Planning on a handoff to next oncall in 30m

Anna (oncall): leaving runbook note: https://runbooks.internal/ops/autoscale-hot-queue (added context about metrics-server cert rotation & manual scale)

Sophie (sre): follow-ups: (a) add probe/restart hardening for metrics-server (b) add fallback path for HPA (external scaler or manual target) (c) investigate spot instance eviction mitigation for critical nodepools. I'll open tickets

Anna (oncall): will monitor for 30m then handoff to next oncall. thanks all :heart:
